claim: Ranked leads endpoint returns 5782 rows with exposure_score>=60, of which 3887 are outside Texas and 5780 are unverified_seed, including 3908 already marked PERMIT_DETECTED.
evidence: queries/03_customer_surface_and_eligibility.py run 2026-10-13T20:46:46Z; identical counts in queries/08_self_check.py at 2026-10-13T20:57:27Z
share: 5782/11270 scored = 51.3%; 3887/5782 of the ranked set = 67.2% non-TX
customer_impact: A contractor can be shown a New York or Seattle building as a DFW hail lead, including rows the database already marked as having a permit.
recommended_fix: Require state TX, outbound_ready=1, and a live provenance, and exclude PERMIT_DETECTED, before a row can be returned.
regression_test: Ranked query returns 0 rows where state<>'TX' OR data_provenance='unverified_seed' OR verification_status='PERMIT_DETECTED'.

claim: 1095 scored leads have cad_total_valuation exactly equal to building_sqft*165 while the parcel table has 0 such rows. Live DCAD shows 16850 Dallas Pkwy as 11994 sq ft, year 1979, value $1,625,000 against stored 33083 sq ft, year 1996, value $5,458,695. 315 Dallas parcels store year 1996 with source missing.
evidence: queries/03 at 2026-10-13T20:46:46Z; re-run queries/08 at 2026-10-13T20:57:27Z (1095 and 0); DCAD HTML in queries/live_pages and screenshot screenshots/dcad_16850_year_area.png retrieved 2026-10-13T20:52Z and viewed 2026-10-13T21:01Z
rows_affected: 1095 scored valuations; 315 Dallas year_built=1996 with source missing
root_cause: 165-times writer is no longer in the tree; detector is outbound_qa_check.py:20. Year fallback is batch_dallas_enrichment.py:228
customer_impact: Ranked leads show a valuation and a 1996 year that the county page contradicts.
recommended_fix: Null cad_total_valuation where it equals building_sqft*165, and null year_built where the source is missing or the value is the 1996 fallback.
regression_test: Count of ABS(cad_total_valuation-building_sqft*165)<1 is 0, and count of year_built=1996 AND year_built_source='missing' is 0.

claim: Outbound-ready parcel 14222 Dallas Pkwy is a 217-unit, 2-story apartment. Stored stories=1, footprint 246961=round(379940*0.65), replacement mid $2,321,434. Live foundation is 97139 sq ft and live land area is 355418 sq ft. Two other ready leads are priced from the same 0.65 footprint.
evidence: queries/02 outbound row; queries/07 at 2026-10-13T20:55:41Z; DCAD page screenshot screenshots/dcad_14222_apartment.png
rows_affected: 1 ready apartment; 3 ready leads priced from land*0.65; 136 parcels with that footprint; 78 scored costs equal to that footprint*9.4
root_cause: lead_quality.py:189 prices footprint_sqft; apartment filters match property_type and owner text, which are blank or do not contain APARTMENT (intelligence.py:64)
customer_impact: A lead marked ready to send is multifamily housing with a replacement price about 2.5 times the foundation.
recommended_fix: Block MFR and apartment improvement descriptions, and reject footprint values equal to round(land_sqft*0.65).
regression_test: No outbound_ready row whose DCAD description or land state code contains APARTMENT or MFR, and no footprint equal to round(land_sqft*0.65).

claim: 2333 leads store hail distance exactly 1.5 miles. Recomputed haversine to the nearest same-state SPC point differs by more than 1 mile on 4165 of 4241 compared leads, and by more than 5 miles on 3833. The two ready leads that quote 7.33 and 3.63 miles match a hardcoded point, while a closer SPC report exists (3.78 and 1.06 miles).
evidence: queries/03 distance pile; queries/04b_spc_corrected.py at 2026-10-13T20:51:07Z; queries/08 at 2026-10-13T20:57:27Z for the two hardcoded distances; SPC page screenshot screenshots/spc_260425_utc.png
rows_affected: 2333 leads at exactly 1.5 miles; 4165 leads with distance error > 1 mile
root_cause: batch_stage2_hail_proximity.py:5 hardcoded points; distance 1.5 is a constant on New York and Chicago rows
customer_impact: Quoted hail proximity on the ranked list and on two ready leads is not the distance to the nearest SPC report.
recommended_fix: Store the SPC file, time, lat, lon, and comment used, and set distance from haversine to the nearest report.
regression_test: Fail when ABS(stored distance - haversine to nearest same-state SPC point) > 0.25.

claim: 522 New York leads use event_date 2026-03-17 and all 522 have exposure_score>=60. The SPC hail CSV and wind CSV for convective day 260317 each contain only a header.
evidence: queries/04b; re-download in queries/08 at 2026-10-13T20:57:28Z, hail 49 bytes 0 rows, wind 50 bytes 0 rows
share: 522/11270 = 4.6% of scored leads; 522/5782 = 9.0% of the ranked set
root_cause: Storm name was written onto scored_parcel_leads without a row in the SPC daily file
customer_impact: The ranked list names a storm date that is not in the SPC hail or wind file.
recommended_fix: Delete or unscore any lead whose event_date has zero SPC hail and wind rows.
regression_test: For every distinct scored event_date, the SPC hail or wind CSV has at least one data row.

claim: 300 of 692 storm swaths have no hail row in the claimed state on that SPC convective-day file, and 172 have a stored maximum more than 0.25 inch away from the state maximum. 796 scored centroids are outside the polygon of their assigned date. A 45 m north offset flips 16 centroids.
rows_affected: 300 swaths with no state hail row; 796 leads outside their assigned polygon
root_cause: harvest_noaa_storms.py writes a swath per metro day; lead_dossier_builder.py:109 matches the newest containing polygon. Hardcoded May 28 polygon is noaa_client.py:42
customer_impact: A dossier can attach a storm the building is not inside, including the May 28 2024 fallback of 2.50 inches.
recommended_fix: Build swaths only from SPC points in that state and day, and require the centroid to fall inside the polygon.
regression_test: Every swath date has a same-state SPC hail row, and every scored centroid is inside its assigned polygon or has a null storm.

claim: Dallas ArcGIS permits link to a parcel on 61 of 14336 rows (0.43%). DallasNow Accela live links 0 of 3226. Fort Worth zip_centroid permits link 0 of 6729. A hand review of 60 linked pairs found 14 on the wrong street or number.
evidence: queries/02 at 2026-10-13T20:43:26Z; queries/06 and queries/07 sample seed 20261014; hand review of the 15 script flags left 14 true mismatches and 1 suite token
rows_affected: 61/14336 Dallas ArcGIS; 0/3226 DallasNow; 0/6729 Fort Worth centroids; 14/60 sampled links
share: Dallas ArcGIS link rate 0.43%; false-link rate 14/60 = 23.3%, Wilson 95% CI 0.144 to 0.354
root_cause: spatial_permit_matcher.py and apply_phase_a.py:254 (zip centroid nulling). Street match does not require the street name.
customer_impact: No-permit conclusions are drawn from a join that misses almost all Dallas permits and that attaches the wrong building when it does link.
recommended_fix: Link only when street number and street name both match, and publish a recall sample against the city feed.
regression_test: Street number and core street name match on every non-null parcel_id. Recall of 30 city roof permits is logged with a Wilson interval.

claim: 2094 of 5782 ranked leads have a New York housing building class. Live PLUTO shows 105 Duane Street as class D6, 440 units, 53 floors, while the lead says Commercial Warehouse and score 99. 493 Main Street is class B2 with 2 units and score 99. DCAD shows 15775 Hillcrest as a church and 14350 Dallas Pkwy as a 232-unit apartment.
evidence: queries/03 class counts; queries/08 PLUTO fetch 2026-10-13T20:57:31Z; golden_set.csv; DCAD HTML for 15775 Hillcrest and 14350 Dallas Pkwy
rows_affected: 2094 ranked rows with NYC housing classes; plus the Dallas church and apartments opened live
root_cause: Eligibility filters match owner and property_type strings (city_verification_runner.py, intelligence.py:64) and do not read PLUTO class or the DCAD improvement description
customer_impact: Housing and a church are scored as commercial roof leads. Building area on a 53-story building is the gross area, not the roof.
recommended_fix: Exclude PLUTO classes A-D and DCAD descriptions containing apartment, church, or MFR before scoring.
regression_test: No scored row with PLUTO bldgclass starting with A, B, C, or D, and no scored row whose live improvement description contains APARTMENT or CHURCH.

claim: Customer UI and dossier text say verified or 100% on fields that are not gated by the release view. The ranked endpoint reads scored_parcel_leads directly, not release_parcels.
evidence: src/components/proof-card.tsx:67; src/lib/live/load.ts:176; lead_dossier_builder.py:238; generate_markdown_dossier.py:15; release_fields has 25 columns (queries/01)
rows_affected: Every proof card, and every ranked lead (5782)
root_cause: proof-card.tsx hardcodes provenance kind verified-record; intelligence.py:261 selects the scored table
customer_impact: The word verified appears on year, permit status, and hail even when the row is an unverified seed or an out-of-polygon parcel.
recommended_fix: Render provenance from the source tag, and serve customers only columns listed in release_fields.
regression_test: A UI snapshot of an unverified_seed row must not contain the string verified-record.

claim: 18087 permits carry issue_date 2026-10-06 with date_quality substituted. 8015 Dallas ArcGIS permits have valuation exactly 20000 and 262 have valuation exactly 75000, matching the injector defaults.
rows_affected: 18087 substituted dates; 8015 valuations of 20000; 262 valuations of 75000
root_cause: batch_dallas_permit_injector.py:207 and :218; apply_phase_a.py:44 labels the non-Texas jurisdictions substituted
customer_impact: The release view hides the substituted date and does not list valuation. A query on the base table still returns the default job value.
recommended_fix: Null valuation when it equals the 20000 or 75000 default, and null issue_date when date_quality is substituted.
regression_test: Count of valuation IN (20000, 75000) on DALLAS_ARCGIS_FY24 is 0 after the cleanup, and substituted rows have a null issue_date in every customer query.
